comment: Gordon is a really nice guy and wants his students to do well. He's extremely passionate about history as well, although it's hard to stay awake in class. A lot of reading and writing, but he grades generously.
Nice professor who wants his students to do well and gives fair assignments. However can be very boring at times and is writing intensive.

Prof Gordon was extremely nice and helpful outside of class.  He has taught 40 yrs and often reverts back to old technology/ teaching style, which I liked a lot since it was different than other profs.  He is a fair grader. He used a lot of textbooks which got expensive, and it was hard staying awake in class but overall I liked the experience.

Had Dr. Gordon for the Winston Churchill history class.  It was an interesting subject and I learned a lot about Churchill and being a historian.  Dr. Gordon was an extremely caring and helpful professor, probably the nicest I have had.  There is A LOT of reading and writing in this class, but the grading is pretty chill.  Good class.
This professor has been excellent to study with.  He's extraordinarily generous with his time and resources.

I fell in love with Ireland after taking the class, but I still had days where it was impossible to stay awake.  He's a fair grader, I never managed to get anything but a B+, but it can def. be done. He's a really nice guy and loves the students. If you like Irish or British history, take him, but be prepared to bring coffee.

Professor Gordon is awsome. Really knows his stuff; really approachable outside of class.  For anyone who thinks he's a tough grader, he's not.  If you do the work, you'll get at least a B; you have to really mess up and not do any work to get a C.  My tip to getting As in his class is keep your paper lengths short.  Good classroom experience.

First I should say that Gordon is a really nice guy with a kind heart. However, he is incredibly boring, rarely gives A's, assigns a large reading list and many papers, and did I mention that he was boring? Don't take him unless you are really interested in history or Britain.

I love this man; he's really nice and flexible.  He's kind of like that teacher you always envisioned you'd have in college; really ancient but knowledgable and interested in what he's teaching.  He is a bit boring, but that's only if you don't do the reading, which was a lot in this course, but worth it.  I say take him.

Wonderful person, somewhat doddering...easy A- but don't expect better.  Assigned a huge (7+) number of papers, generally in the 5-6 page range but several were longer.  They were easy to write, but there were so many.
Dr. Gordon is a wonderful human being, but one of the most boring professors I've ever had.  As far as grading goes, he's pretty fair, but rarely gives As.
Although the subject matter of Churchill was interesting, the lectures about put everyone to sleep. Not a lot of required work. Easy to get a B+, hard to get an A.
